name: minions-bundles-knowledge-workspace
description: Knowledge management bundle — documents, concepts, citations
author: Mehdi Nabhani <mehdi@the-mehdi.com> (https://the-mehdi.com)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-core run build && pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-cli run build && pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-docs run build && pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-blog run build && pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-web run build
scripts.deploy:blog: pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-blog run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/blog/dist --prod
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-docs run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/docs/dist --prod
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-web run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/web/dist --prod
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-core run build && pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-core run lint && pnpm --filter @mxn2020/minions-bundles-knowledge-cli run lint
